page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top. Page number at top right. Signature at bottom left and catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: debatur adiuuare, transfitusque Germani è templo Deiparæ virginis ad sanctam Sophiam & rursum provocatio ad cundū, diffidentiaq;, ppterea quod Andreas quidam ibi continuo obambularet, qui supplicationibus inde spem intercluderet. Tumultus &incendium in urbe domus Constantini patricii, qui Lartes à vulgo cognominabatur, & desperatio fugaque Mauricij: quomodo cum æstus esset maris, iter fugæ sit præcisum: missioq; Theodosij ad Chosroen, ciusq; iterum Nicæa reditus cum annulum ci ostendisset, quem filio tesseræ signíuc loco pater dederat: & quomodo ad tyrannum cives, inter quos erat etiam Septimi quod vocabatur loci præfectus, exiuerit, quomodoque Germanus in affectando regno successu exciderit, pra-finis ideo prorsus reclamantibus, quia, vt dicebant, factionis erat Venetæ. Ceterum, renunciatio in sancti Iohannis templo, quod erat in Septimo, Phocæ, adhibitis riteque factis regni ceremoniis à Cyriaco, introitusq; Phocæ, & salutatio Leontiæ uxoris Phocæ, ac tribunorum de locis contentio & expulsio Cosmæ tribuni plebis Venetæ per Alexandrum, contentioq; cum Alexandro, in eaq; forte mentio facta, quod nondum esset mortuus Mauricius: & propterea festinatio tyranni furorq; in cæde Imperatoris; adhæc occidio, filiórū regis in cóspectu patris, in portu qui vocatur Eutropij: modestia itē & regis feria pietatis cófessio: ipsiusq; illius cædes manu Lilij ac Mauricij Imp. testaménti, in quo scriptus hæres rex Heraclius erat, inuenti prælectio: quomodoq; corpora regia marino fluctui exposita: funebris item oratio super Mauricio, & quomodo ultio-

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Ligatures (ƈt, st) expanded to ct and st. "cundū" is uncertain and could be "cunctū"; left as printed. "cófpectu" and "cófessio" keep the printed accent over the o. The text is printed in small type on a scan with show-through and edge marks of the neighbouring page at the left and right margins, which are not transcribed. The column is continuous with no paragraph break on this page; the last word "vltio-" is a catchword and is therefore also given in bottom_margin, with the line ending on the hyphen.
